about: G-08. The four-unit law of the theory book (ch. 14): at most 4 (all 75) and the A, B, C, D cuts from base-R rows, its pair errors from the postrank golden of the same law and the weighted errors from the base-R row; exactly 4 among all 24 strict orders from the registry (part2-g08.json). Two cases script the prediction (Check with the right and with a wrong answer).
